# Breathe Getaway

> Guides on studying and job hunting with AI.

## Guides
- [How to study faster with AI (and actually remember it)](https://breathegetaway.ai/study-faster-with-ai/): Use AI to explain, quiz and summarize so you learn faster, without just copying answers. A simple routine for any class.
- [How to apply to more jobs in less time](https://breathegetaway.ai/apply-to-more-jobs-faster/): Practical ways to send more tailored job applications each week: a master resume, fast tailoring, and autofill for long application forms.
- [How to summarize a lecture or YouTube video in minutes](https://breathegetaway.ai/summarize-a-lecture-or-youtube-video/): Get the main points of a long lecture or video fast, then quiz yourself on it. Works for recorded classes, YouTube and online courses.
- [How to make flashcards with AI (Anki and Quizlet)](https://breathegetaway.ai/make-flashcards-with-ai/): Turn notes, slides or a textbook chapter into flashcards in minutes with AI, then review them with spaced repetition so they stick.
- [How to study for finals in less time](https://breathegetaway.ai/how-to-study-for-finals/): A finals plan that works: start a week out, quiz yourself instead of re-reading, space your reviews, and sleep. With AI shortcuts for each step.
- [How to write a cover letter fast (that still sounds like you)](https://breathegetaway.ai/write-a-cover-letter-fast/): A simple three-paragraph cover letter you can tailor in minutes, plus how to use AI without sounding generic.
- [How to fill out online job applications faster](https://breathegetaway.ai/fill-out-job-applications-faster/): Why online job applications take so long and how to get through them faster: a resume tailored to each job, saved answers, and autofill.
- [How to tailor your resume to a job description in 10 minutes](https://breathegetaway.ai/tailor-resume-to-job-description/): A quick method to match your resume to each job posting so it gets past screening and in front of a person.
- [How to get homework help from AI that actually teaches you](https://breathegetaway.ai/ai-homework-help-step-by-step/): Use AI like a tutor: get hints and step-by-step explanations for math, science and essays instead of just answers.
- [Reading tools that help with ADHD and dyslexia](https://breathegetaway.ai/read-faster-adhd-dyslexia/): Free ways to have pages read out loud and explained in plain words on Mac and Windows, plus tips for long readings.
- [How to take better lecture notes (and use them to study)](https://breathegetaway.ai/take-better-lecture-notes/): A simple note-taking method for lectures, whether to type or handwrite, and how to turn notes into quiz questions afterward.
- [How to answer common job application questions fast](https://breathegetaway.ai/answer-job-application-questions/): Ready-to-adapt answers for 'Why do you want to work here?', salary expectations, work authorization and other questions that show up on every application.
- [How to follow up on a job application (with examples)](https://breathegetaway.ai/follow-up-after-job-application/): When to follow up after applying, who to email, and short follow-up messages you can copy.
- [Tools to fill out job applications faster: what each one does](https://breathegetaway.ai/tools-to-apply-to-jobs-faster/): Autofill, resume tailoring, cover letters and tracking: which job application tools handle which step, including Simplify, Teal, Huntr, ChatGPT and Utterseen.
- [Tools to get work done faster on your computer](https://breathegetaway.ai/tools-to-get-work-done-faster/): AI assistants, voice tools, task managers and automation: which productivity tools save the most time, from ChatGPT and Copilot to Todoist, Zapier and Utterseen.
- [Top 10 AI tools for students in 2026](https://breathegetaway.ai/top-10-ai-tools-for-students/): The best AI tools for studying: Utterseen, ChatGPT, NotebookLM, Quizlet, Anki, Claude, Perplexity, Otter, Grammarly and Khanmigo, and what each one is best for.
- [Top 10 AI tools for job seekers in 2026](https://breathegetaway.ai/top-10-ai-tools-for-job-seekers/): The best AI tools for finding and applying to jobs: Utterseen, Simplify, Teal, Jobscan, Huntr, ChatGPT, Claude, LinkedIn, Google Interview Warmup and Glassdoor.
- [Simplify vs Teal vs Huntr vs Utterseen: job application tools compared](https://breathegetaway.ai/simplify-vs-teal-vs-huntr-vs-utterseen/): A side-by-side comparison of four popular job application tools: what each does, where it works, and which to use for resumes, autofill and tracking.
- [ChatGPT vs NotebookLM vs Utterseen for studying](https://breathegetaway.ai/chatgpt-vs-notebooklm-vs-utterseen-for-studying/): Which AI is best for studying? A comparison of ChatGPT, Google NotebookLM and Utterseen for explanations, summaries, study guides and flashcards.

## News
- [AI assistants that can see your screen: what they do and which to try](https://breathegetaway.ai/news/ai-assistants-that-see-your-screen/): ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Meta AI and Utterseen can all look at what's on your screen. How screen-aware AI works, what each one does, and how they differ.
- [Tool spotlight: Google NotebookLM turns your notes into a study partner](https://breathegetaway.ai/news/tool-spotlight-google-notebooklm/): NotebookLM answers questions using only the sources you upload, and makes summaries, study guides, flashcards and audio overviews. How students use it.
- [Tool spotlight: Anki, the free flashcard app medical students swear by](https://breathegetaway.ai/news/tool-spotlight-anki/): Anki uses spaced repetition to show you each flashcard right before you'd forget it. Why it works, what it costs, and how to fill it with cards fast.
- [Tool spotlight: Simplify Copilot, the free autofill extension for job applications](https://breathegetaway.ai/news/tool-spotlight-simplify-copilot/): Simplify Copilot saves your profile and autofills job applications in your browser, and tracks where you've applied. What it does well and where it falls short.
- [Tool spotlight: Google Interview Warmup lets you practice interview answers for free](https://breathegetaway.ai/news/tool-spotlight-google-interview-warmup/): Google's free Interview Warmup asks real interview questions, transcribes your spoken answers, and highlights the job terms you used. How to get the most out of it.
- [Tool spotlight: Utterseen, the AI that sees your screen](https://breathegetaway.ai/news/tool-of-the-week-utterseen/): Utterseen is a voice AI for Mac and Windows that answers questions about anything on your screen, makes study guides and flashcards, and applies to jobs with a tailored resume.
